subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘VIOLENT’ is coded as ‘104’ and ‘UPDATED’ is coded as ‘78’. How will ‘TOUCHED’ be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/604ae908170aa96c927f5a3ddae206d7dfc9a81ae28a6f58f1c286d8df90f945.png] **The logic followed here is: Sum of the positional values of the letters + 7 (Sum of the no. of letter in a word)** For, VIOLENT
